start_here: Say to your AI: "Check which files my kept-files list says I can get back and show me what would go to Trash, moving nothing", with {"rows": [{"id": "synthetic:dry-run", "value": {}}], "dry_run": true}. It runs tool:free-what-the-list-says-can-be-got-back and answers what is eligible and how many bytes it would free.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of its own: it reads the rows you pass from your own list of files and how to get them back.
instructions: 1. Read up to 100 rows of your list of files and how to get them back (each { id, value }).
2. Say "Show me what can go to Trash". The AI runs tool:free-what-the-list-says-can-be-got-back with those rows; dry_run is true unless you say otherwise, so nothing moves.
3. Read eligible_count, eligible_path_bytes and each row's reason; when it is right, run it again with "dry_run": false inside the folder you granted, and the files go to the recoverable Trash.
